case.question: Osborn flips Ricketts for Nebraska Senate by November 2?

pmo_methodology_facts.calculation: Each venue/hour uses median of per-minute observations (up to 60); source listing excluded if fewer than 20 samples. Site publishes no new hour unless at least two exchanges contribute. Sources weighted by liquidity; per-contract probability averages 250-share buy and sell average prices; excludes insufficient 250-share liquidity or >8pp spread; resolved sources map to 99.9/0.1, specified one-sided-book exceptions.
pmo_methodology_facts.coverage_warning: Methodology page disclaims guaranteed uptime, accuracy, methodology, or availability.
pmo_methodology_facts.listing: Nebraska Senate Election 2026; candidate detail links and Odds History chart plus JSON data feed exposed in listing shell.
pmo_methodology_facts.representation: API value is decimal fraction, rounded to 0.001 (equivalent to 0.1 percentage point); listing/chart presents percent. History chart maps null hourly values to visible no-print gaps.

rule_facts.comparison: Dan Osborn (I) strictly higher than Pete Ricketts (R) for 4 consecutive published hourly values, compared at 0.1 percentage-point precision; equality ends run. PMO NO_PRINT hours are disregarded, neither counting nor ending a run. If no hourly values for both are published in window, No. Official underlying-market decision before deadline settles Yes iff Osborn is outcome. A clearly erroneous hourly value may be corrected within 48h of first publication; corrected value replaces original, otherwise original stands and later revisions are ignored.

time_window.boundary_note: First observed post-createdAt hourly row ends 04:00Z but spans 03:00Z–04:00Z, overlapping creation by 49.9 sec; rule names publication datapoint, while PMO row exposes a window rather than a separate publication timestamp.

scope: facts only; no probability, selection, rejection, account, execution, or ledger action

series_snapshot.eligible_slice_rule: window_end > Gamma createdAt and <= latest feed generated_at; the initial overlapping hourly window is retained with boundary caveat above.
series_snapshot.scope_limit: Snapshot through feed generation at 09:00Z 2026-10-21; future hours, later corrections, permanent source cessation, and official decision are not observed.
